title: On the simplicial structure of uncertain information
summary: The mathematical representation of uncertainty has led to a proliferation of preference structures, such as interval-valued fuzzy sets, intuitionistic fuzzy sets, and various granular models. While these extensions are often studied independently, they share profound geometric and topological foundations. This paper provides a unifying framework by identifying these disparate structures with the simplicial geometry of $n$-dimensional fuzzy sets.
